cues.text: In flat shades of blue, Aigis walks along a railing past city buildings. The credits roll.
A large drawing of Fuuka's face appears beside her, then scenes from the story.
Koromaru.
The team gathers in a lamplit square.
Ken.
A policeman rests a hand on a small boy's shoulder.
Akihiko.
Junpei, in a cap, grinning.
Mitsuru, her long hair blowing.
Yukari.
Metis.
In a clip, Metis and Aigis stand face to face, and light bursts around them.
Aigis walks on alone.
Now she walks a seaside promenade. Wind turbines turn on the far shore.
She lifts a hand to her ear, then walks on.
A school bag swings in her hand.
She raises a hand to her ear again.
A tall iron fence, cherry blossoms pink behind it.
She stops by an arched gate and looks up.
She holds out a palm to the falling petals.
She turns back, and the picture fades to blue, then black.
